title: Perform principal component analysis on project data — pca
text: Performs scaled principal component analysis (PCA) selected numeric project-level shuttle-box metrics. PCA summarises correlated metrics new axes. title: Perform principal component analysis on project data — pca
text: data Project-results data containing one row per trial individual. variables Character vector naming numeric variables include PCA. Supplying argument recommended makes analysis explicit prevents newly added numeric columns silently changing PCA. NULL, suitable numeric columns used. mahalanobis_th Probability used chi-squared Mahalanobis distance cutoff. Default 0.99. Larger values conservative flag fewer fish. dbscan_th eps value supplied DBSCAN. Default 1.5. Larger values generally join neighbouring fish flag fewer locally isolated. dbscan_minPts Minimum number neighbouring points required DBSCAN. Default 4. Larger values generally make density screen stringent, although effect depends sample size structure. flag_rule Rule used define fish highlighted candidates review. One "" (default), "either", "mahalanobis", "dbscan". "" conservative highlights fish identified screens. print_labels Logical. Show labels individuals PCA plots. Default TRUE. Flagged fish labelled highlight_outliers TRUE even print_labels = FALSE. id_col Identifier column. Default "fileID". var_col Variable plotted PC1. Default "Tpref". biplot_variables Logical. Show variable vectors biplot. highlight_outliers Logical. Circle label fish selected flag_rule biplot PC1-variable plot. Default TRUE. n_driver_variables Number unusually high low original variables reported fish detected least one screen. Default 3.

Expanded README vignette check--calculate workflow, guidance interpreting segmented plots, examples whole-period versus settled-period activity metrics.

text: Replaced bundled single-trial example uploaded Fish_14_13_2.txt ShuttleSoft recording updated README, vignette, function examples, generated help pages accordingly. Added rendered bivariate matrix vignette using correlation_matrix(), together guidance reading scatterplot panels, smooth trends, correlation coefficients using matrix PCA.

title: ShuttleboxR 0.0.0.9010
text: Replaced default IQR screen temperature-limit exposure direct 10% exposure threshold plot_limits_vs_distance(), plot_limits_vs_shuttles(), plot_upper_vs_lower_extremes(). Added limit_method = "absolute", "quantile", "iqr", together adjustable absolute quantile thresholds. absolute method now default remains interpretable zero-heavy project datasets. Renamed review categories describe threshold exceedance rather implying non-zero exposure biologically high. Updated README vignette explain IQR thresholds can collapse zero set study-appropriate limit-exposure thresholds. Changed ggplot-based package figures, including PCA figures produced factoextra, theme_classic() gridlines.

title: ShuttleboxR 0.0.0.9009
text: Added explicit variables argument pca(). makes metrics included PCA transparent prevents PCA changing silently new numeric columns added project database. Added dbscan_minPts control minimum local neighbourhood size used DBSCAN. Added flag_rule = "", "either", "mahalanobis", "dbscan" control detections highlighted candidates review. Made default PCA screening conservative (mahalanobis_th = 0.99, dbscan_th = 1.5, dbscan_minPts = 4, flag_rule = ""). Added fish-level screening table flagged_ids output retaining method-level outliers table. outlier_details now indicates whether fish selected chosen flag rule. Revised README vignette explain PCA results change selected variables change, threshold affects sensitivity, one-method signals differ fish identified methods.
